mechanism: The split is gene-disjoint but not family-disjoint: every test variant's Pfam family appears in training, and labels follow per-family propensity, so a model can score well by memorizing family label rates. Gene-level disjointness is only the appearance of a clean split; the generalization claimed (to unrelated genes) is untested.
quantify: 100% of test variants share their pfam family with training
a family label-rate baseline reaches AUROC ~0.88
fix: Split at the family level (no test variant's family in training), or report AUROC within families unseen in training.
